notes: Dynamax Desktop v3.1.32 repairs online CBT downloads. Pull Online Tests defaults to today (server local date), lets officers load another date and select individual tests or all tests for that date, and downloads in the background with progress and a complete report. Ordinary compressed PDF data no longer causes false active-content rejections; real scripts, attachments and unsafe actions remain blocked. Failed papers do not stop later subjects, retries preserve tests already saved, and local student logins keep eligible downloaded tests available. Existing attempts and online roster safeguards are preserved. Includes the subscriber school logo, independent CBT centres, staff recovery, HR repairs and previous updates. Install on each CBT server while exams are stopped. Installation preserves organisation settings and existing records.
